title: When Money Grew on Trees in Tenochtitlan
hook: In the Aztec empire, cacao beans were official legal tender.

scenes.text: In the bustling capital of Tenochtitlan, people didn't trade using coins of silver or gold—they paid in chocolate.
scenes.imagePrompt: Vibrant bustling Aztec market stall in Tenochtitlan under woven awnings with woven baskets overflowing with dried brown cacao beans. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In the bustling capital of Tenochtitlan, people didn't trade using coins of silver or gold—they paid in chocolate.

scenes.text: Dried cacao beans were official legal currency: one bean bought a fresh ripe avocado, three bought a tamale, and one hundred bought a fine mantle.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up of dried cacao beans resting in an engraved ceramic clay bowl beside fresh green avocados and ears of golden maize. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Dried cacao beans were official legal currency: one bean bought a fresh ripe avocado, three bought a tamale, and one hundred bought a fine mantle.

scenes.text: Because money literally grew on trees, counterfeiters emerged: scoundrels emptied real cacao shells, filled them with dirt, and glued them shut.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dimly lit stone workshop table with cracked cacao pods, fine brown river clay, and obsidian blades used for crafting fake beans. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Because money literally grew on trees, counterfeiters emerged: scoundrels emptied real cacao shells, filled them with dirt, and glued them shut.

scenes.text: Market judges tested suspicious beans by squeezing them between their fingers to check for hollow crunching sounds.

scenes.text: Nobles enjoyed drinking their wealth: frothed spicy chocolate whipped with chili peppers, vanilla orchids, and wild bees honey.
